title: Riverbend Term Schedule by Balance for Patient Payment Plan Offers
content:
**Rule.** A **Patient Payment Plan** offer that carries the tier's maximum term runs only as long as the offer's balance term allows, Riverbend's term schedule by balance read from the offer's ledger as the amounts enrolled less the reductions booked: 60 installments when that balance is at least 10000.00 and 48 installments when it is at least 3000.00, the first of these that applies, each only on tiers whose maximum term is shorter and only for an offer carrying the tier's maximum term; otherwise the balance term is the offer's number of monthly installments.

| Tier | Tier maximum term | Offer at the maximum term, ledger balance at least 10000.00 | At the maximum term, at least 3000.00 and below 10000.00 | Below 3000.00, or offer shorter than the maximum term |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 6 | 60 | 48 | the offer's own term |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 12 | 60 | 48 | the offer's own term |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 24 | 60 | 48 | the offer's own term |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 36 | 60 | 48 | the offer's own term |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 48 | 60 | 48 | the offer's own term |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 60 | 60 | 60 | the offer's own term |

**Hypothetical.** An offer at a 36-installment maximum term with 11000.00 enrolled and 1500.00 of reductions has a ledger balance of 9500.00 and a balance term of 48; with no reductions the balance term would be 60.
